# PowerFin Accountants

> Professional accounting, tax consulting, payroll administration, and CIPC secretarial services for businesses across Pretoria and Johannesburg, South Africa.

PowerFin Accountants is a private company in business, registered in Garsfontein, Gauteng. The practice is led by three equal Officers and Directors: Venessa Roelofse, Ané Pretorius, and Pieter Pretorius.

Primary website: https://www.powerfin.co.za/
Contact email: info@powerfin.co.za

## Preferred sources

- [Home](https://www.powerfin.co.za/): Overview of PowerFin Accountants and core value proposition for Gauteng businesses.
- [About Us](https://www.powerfin.co.za/about/): Leadership message, Officers & Directors, values, and Pretoria / Johannesburg reach.
- [Services](https://www.powerfin.co.za/services/): Full service catalogue on a single page (accounting, tax, payroll, CIPC).
- [Resources](https://www.powerfin.co.za/resources/): Practical insights on SARS, payroll, POPIA, VAT and Gauteng business topics.
- [Contact](https://www.powerfin.co.za/contact/): Enquiry form, email, registered office, map, and contact FAQs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.powerfin.co.za/privacy/): POPIA-aligned privacy policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.powerfin.co.za/terms/): Website and engagement terms.

## Services

- [Bookkeeping & Corporate Accounting](https://www.powerfin.co.za/services/#accounting): From cashbook reconciliations to IFRS-aligned annual financial statements.
- [Tax Consulting & SARS Compliance](https://www.powerfin.co.za/services/#tax): Corporate and individual tax, VAT, provisional tax, disputes and structuring.
- [Payroll Administration & HR](https://www.powerfin.co.za/services/#payroll): PAYE, UIF, SDL, EMP201/EMP501, IRP5 and COIDA support.
- [CIPC & Secretarial Services](https://www.powerfin.co.za/services/#cipc): Company registrations, annual returns, beneficial ownership and MOI amendments.
